legislation.title: An Act Requiring The Department Of Economic And Community Development To Develop A Plan To Establish An Artificial Intelligence Small Business Program.
legislation.summary: This bill directs Connecticut's economic development agency to create a plan for an AI small business support program. It is aimed at helping small businesses access and benefit from artificial intelligence tools and resources.

legislation.title: An Act Concerning Online Safety.
legislation.summary: This Connecticut bill creates a sweeping AI regulatory framework, including a new AI Policy Office, workforce training programs, disclosure requirements for AI providers, and rules restricting discriminatory use of automated employment decisions. It also requires synthetic digital content to be detectable and establishes safe harbor programs for companies that comply with AI standards.

legislation.title: An Act Concerning Consumer Privacy And Protection.
legislation.summary: This Connecticut bill strengthens consumer privacy protections by regulating data brokers, restricting the use of facial recognition technology, prohibiting the sale of precise location data, and requiring businesses to disclose when they use algorithms to set personalized prices. It also expands worker rights by removing exemptions that previously allowed employers to use automated systems for employment decisions without the same privacy rules that apply to other data uses.

legislation.title: An Act Concerning Democracy And Government Accountability And The Use And Retention Of Data Derived From Automated License Plate Reader Systems.
legislation.summary: This bill regulates how automated license plate reader systems collect, use, and retain data in Connecticut. It focuses on government accountability and sets rules around law enforcement's use of this surveillance technology.

legislation.title: An Act Establishing A Task Force To Study The Effects Of Artificial Intelligence On The Trades Industry.
legislation.summary: This bill creates a task force to study how artificial intelligence is affecting skilled trades workers. It also directs the Commissioner of Public Health to look into expanding certified nursing assistant training programs.

legislation.title: An Act Prohibiting The Disclosure Of The Residential Address Of Public School Employees Under The Freedom Of Information Act And Establishing A Task Force Concerning Mass Requests Under The Act.
legislation.summary: This bill prohibits releasing residential addresses of public school employees under freedom of information requests and creates a task force to study how mass automated requests—potentially generated by artificial intelligence—affect public records systems. The AI element is limited to studying the problem of AI-generated bulk requests rather than regulating AI itself.

legislation.title: An Act Concerning Automated Decision Systems Protections For Employees.
legislation.summary: This bill sets rules for how employers in Connecticut can use automated systems and AI when making decisions about workers, such as hiring, firing, or promotions. It requires transparency and establishes protections to ensure employees are treated fairly when AI is involved in workplace decisions.

legislation.title: An Act Addressing Innovations In And The Responsible Use Of Artificial Intelligence.
legislation.summary: This Connecticut bill establishes a framework for the responsible development and use of artificial intelligence, implementing the Governor's recommendations for AI oversight. It likely includes rules around transparency, safety, and accountability for AI systems used in the state.

legislation.title: An Act Concerning Direct-to-consumer Genetic Testing.
legislation.summary: This bill grants consumers property rights over their biological samples and genetic test results from direct-to-consumer genetic testing companies, and imposes duties and limitations on how these companies handle genetic data. It establishes consumer control and restrictions on the use of genetic information by testing providers.

legislation.title: An Act Eliminating Certain Tax Incentives For Data Centers.
legislation.summary: This bill would remove existing tax breaks that Connecticut currently offers to data centers. Eliminating these incentives could discourage new data center construction and investment in the state.

legislation.title: An Act Establishing Additional Protections For Warehouse Workers.
legislation.summary: This bill establishes additional protections for warehouse workers, likely addressing working conditions and potentially automated monitoring or quota systems. It aims to regulate how employers can use technology and algorithms to set work pace and performance expectations for warehouse employees.
